panels.beat: Crowded Golden City, only elves; no identifiable Nolf
panels.text: The Golden City could no longer shelter all its people.

panels.beat: Elven council; no identifiable Nolf
panels.text: The great families would leave, each seeking a new home for the elves.

panels.beat: Thalestriel departure, more than one hundred elves and open relic wagon
panels.text: Nolf: Eol, damn you. You have driven us from our home.

panels.beat: Creature attack on the travelling family
panels.text: Nolf: Curse you, Eol! Must your creatures hunt us too?

panels.beat: Hostile attackers, family protecting the relic wagon
panels.text: Nolf: Damn you, Eol. Every road becomes another trap.

panels.beat: Natural disaster strikes the caravan
panels.text: Nolf: Eol, you bastard! Even the land turns against us.

panels.beat: Plague takes hold; Nolf remains unaffected
panels.text: Nolf: Curse you, Eol. Now you send sickness after them.

panels.beat: Most of the caravan lost, non-graphic mourning
panels.text: Nolf: Damn you, Eol. I will not leave the others behind.

panels.beat: Damaged wagon and exactly eight plagued elves lying inside the cave, with Nolf
panels.text: Nolf: Curse you, Eol. We are still here, and we stay together.

panels.beat: Xiar appears after Antlered Hunger is defeated
panels.text: Xiar: Every calamity reaches your family. None touches you. Who are you?

panels.beat: Nolf's former godhood presented as a memory, not a new divine identity design
panels.text: Nolf: I remember another plane. There, I was a goddess.

panels.beat: Nolf offers the memories; Xiar accepts
panels.text: Nolf: Take those memories. Give me a path to power and divinity here. Xiar: Agreed.

panels.beat: Xiar applies the Shadow Mark with her wand
panels.text: Xiar: Receive the Shadow Mark.

panels.beat: Fully clothed elf-to-drow transformation
panels.text: The bargain remade Nolf as a drow.

panels.beat: Wand handed to Nolf, restrained shadow-creature command cue
panels.text: Xiar: XIAR'S KISS is yours. Its bearer can command all shadow creatures.

panels.beat: Nolf completes her established final transformation
panels.text: Nolf's transformation was complete.

panels.beat: Portal opens to the Dream Plane
panels.text: She opened a passage to the Dream Plane.

panels.beat: Nolf and exactly eight drows cross with the open wagon and relics
panels.text: All nine crossed together. No one, and no relic, was left behind.

panels.beat: All nine remain together in the Golden City of Dreams
panels.text: In the Golden City of Dreams, they found their home.

panels.beat: Nolf leaves the wand in the eight drows' collective custody and stays with them
panels.text: XIAR'S KISS remained in the eight drows' care. Nolf remained with them.
